chapter: New York dance bands and Dorsey
title: Joe Haymes's band at the McAlpine Hotel
summary: Freeman joins arranger Joe Haymes's band for about eighteen months at New York's McAlpine Hotel with Pee Wee Erwin and Toots Mondello.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: From there I got an offer to go with Joe Haymes, and I don't think enough has been written about Joe Haymes,

who was a marvelous arranger and pianist but then he stopped playing piano and just wrote for this band and we worked at a place called the McAlpine Hotel in New York for about 18 months and in that band were such great players as Pee Wee Erwin, is still on the scene today, playing very well.
